entries.title: The sand started it
entries.body:
The black sand is full of tiny flashes. I chose the brightest one, bent down and lost it. Straightened up. There it was.

I tried approaching from the other side. That flash went out and three others started. I lowered myself very slowly. They all stopped.

I backed up and found a whole patch of them. Down. Gone. Up. There.

I don't know what the sand thinks we're playing. I've stopped trying to pick it up. I'm just going up and down now.

entries.title: Within reach
entries.body:
She said my antennae were lovely. I had been showing her my clubs. I put those away.

I meant to thank her. Instead I described how far my antennae could reach.

She said she could see that.

I pulled them back. She moved closer.
